summary: Frontend-only iteration 118 Godmode de-clutter verified end-to-end on preview URL. Login (standard@wladbot.test), dashboard structure, ActionInbox widget (expand/collapse/persistence), WladMotivationCard sidebar placement, Continue-As flow for both email + google providers, MagicLinkForm whitespace strip + success state, and mobile layout all pass. Dark-mode toggle works and ActionInbox stays legible.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.js is 317 lines and still growing — right sidebar (motivation + upcoming + referral + wladhub) could be extracted into a DashboardSidebar component for cleaner grid ownership.

ContinueAsCard useContinueAs hook: for provider 'email' the parent gets onMagicSent callback but does not visually switch to the MagicLinkForm sent-state — user sees only the prefilled password form + a toast. Consider surfacing the 'Link verschickt' card as the primary confirmation to avoid ambiguity.
seed_data_creation: localStorage key wladbot_recent_logins_v1 seeded during Continue-As tests (both email and google providers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iter 118 acceptance criteria verified. Verified elements: dashboard-page, action-inbox, action-inbox-toggle, action-inbox-content, event-reminder-banner, wlad-motivation-card (in right column at x=1036 of 1440 vp), next-step-cta, level-progress, referral-upsell-card. Collapse persists across reload via sessionStorage (aria-expanded='false' after reload). Continue-As email: card found, click prefills password form input and triggers POST /api/auth/magic-link/request (success). Continue-As google: card click navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<dashboard>. MagicLinkForm: whitespace input '  test-magic@wladbot.test  ' auto-stripped, submit shows data-testid='magic-link-sent'. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), ActionInbox renders stacked. Dark mode: html.dark toggles, ActionInbox computed color rgb(245,245,245) on rgba(255,255,255,0.02). No JS console errors on dashboard.
